text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One fine day, Symboli Rudolf, Tokai
Teio, and
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi are called
upon to do a
magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... If I recall correctly,
we'll be doing
the
interviews after the photo shoot,
right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The theme of this special
feature is "The Umamusume We Look Up
To." Why don't we
start with you,
Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You always make an impression in your races, and the last was no different! It makes me wonder: in whose footsteps are you trying to follow?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kind words. I always
set out to be a lodestar on which others
can set their sights. As such, I worked
hard to achieve the results I did in that
race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I shall continue striving, body and soul, to be a paragon for others. Put simply, I look up to myself as someone who must, nay—whowill fulfill her potential.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd look up to yourself in
that way! What can I say but, "That's
Symboli Rudolf for
you!" Next, I'd like to
ask about...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and Tokai Teio—the
two of you have experienced
phenomenal growth in
recent years. Is
there anyone you look up to?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who else would I mention aside from the

Prez—Symboli Rudolf?! She's only the
coolest
Umamusume out there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My drive to be just like Prez is what got
me this
far!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
From the moment I enrolled at the academy,
President Rudolf has been a
shining example of the kind of
Umamusume I want to be. And that's 
why I train as hard as I do!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've come as far as I have despite my
fragile health because I had the goal of
becoming just
like President Rudolf to
work towards!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
But, you know...
Well, you know...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Noooot really. It's just... How would you
put it,
Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, there's only one way to answer that question!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There seems to be a commotion at the 
racecourse. I go to investigate and see
that Symboli Rudolf and some others
have started up
a scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, I can't believe I get to interview you and watch you race! Today's my lucky day!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: But why a scrimmage?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be easier to show than tell," huh.
Yeah! I
think that works for us!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right? What better way to share our
feelings than
through racing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True. As they say, "Actions speak louder
than
words."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I knew Prez wouldn't make this
easy! But I
won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I get distracted for even a second,
I'll
get left in
the dust! But I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I can feel their determination from
here...
Are they... getting all this power
from admiration
alone?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(The person we look up to... No, it's not
just
about that.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(We don't just want to follow in her
footsteps. We
want to win—to surpass
her. And that's not all...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Go, Teio, goooo! You're the strongest
racer out
there!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru! Don't give up! You're the one
who'll win it
all in the end!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well done. But I, too, can still
put up a
good fight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd goes wild over the
spectacular race unfolding before their
eyes. The reporter watching them seems
overwhelmed. Though he whispers to
himself, I can hear him clearly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wow... I had it wrong the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
All three of these racers have an
unshakable
belief in their own ability to
win.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's not that they're looking up to each
other as motivation. I need to change
the whole concept of their feature,
starting with the title. I'll call it...
yes... "The Heroic Trio—"
